title: High Pressure Lockout
fullDescription: Coleman/York central AC outdoor units use high-pressure protection. Lockout after 5 trips per cycle.

fixSteps.title: Wash coil
fixSteps.instruction: Shut off, garden hose from inside out.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Low Pressure Lockout
fullDescription: Suction pressure below cutout - charge loss or restriction.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Outdoor Fan Fault
shortDescription: Fan motor not turning or wrong RPM.
fullDescription: ECM fan motors report tach signal back to board. Failed motor or stuck blade trips this.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Compressor Overload
fullDescription: Internal klixon protector opened from heat. 30+ minute cooldown before retry.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Discharge Temp High
fullDescription: Indicates overheating - low charge, restriction, or failing compressor.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Liquid Line Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Liquid line thermistor open or shorted.
fullDescription: Sensor used for charge optimization. Loss disables enhanced control modes.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Communication Loss
shortDescription: Outdoor lost link with indoor on Echelon system.
fullDescription: Coleman Echelon communicating systems use 4-wire bus.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Reversed Phasing (3-phase)
shortDescription: Commercial 3-phase scroll compressor sees wrong rotation.
fullDescription: Coleman commercial RTUs detect phase reversal to protect scroll. Swap any two L1/L2/L3.

fixSteps.title: Swap phases
fixSteps.instruction: Electrician swaps any two of L1/L2/L3 at disconnect.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Float Switch
symptoms: AC stops cooling, water near indoor
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: EEPROM Fault
shortDescription: Board memory corrupted - factory defaults loaded.
fullDescription: Settings reset to defaults. Reconfigure equipment matchup at thermostat.

fixSteps.title: Reconfigure equipment
fixSteps.instruction: Walk through installer setup at thermostat.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: EEPROM Read Failure
fullDescription: EE indicates the indoor control board can't read its EEPROM configuration.

title: Indoor Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F1 means the indoor coil temperature sensor is open or shorted.

title: Outdoor Coil Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F2 indicates the outdoor coil sensor reads invalid.

faq.a: On HP variant — defrost depends on it.

title: Outdoor Ambient Sensor Fault
fullDescription: F3 fires when the outdoor ambient sensor reads out of range.

title: Voltage Out of Range
fullDescription: P1 trips when measured 230V is outside ±10%.

title: Compressor Phase Loss
fullDescription: On 3-phase commercial Coleman AC, P3 fires when one phase is lost.
whenToCallPro: Utility phase loss = call electric company.

title: Compressor Discharge Over-Temp
fullDescription: P4 reports compressor discharge over the safe limit; lockout follows.

title: Outdoor Fan Motor Fault
fullDescription: P6 fires when outdoor fan does not run as commanded.

title: Indoor/Outdoor Comm Loss
fullDescription: U2 indicates comm bus failure between indoor and outdoor units.

title: Reversing Valve Fault (HP variant)
fullDescription: On heat-pump capable Coleman platform, U3 indicates reversing-valve failure.
